label: Transparent v1 constraint severity
notes: Inspectable. Change here only. Not calibrated science. Severity and evidence confidence are separate.
formula: severity = demand_pressure * scarcity * substitution_difficulty * downstream_importance; score = round(100 * severity). evidence_confidence is reported separately and does NOT multiply into score.

relief.description: Material capacity relief: lower capacity and lead-time pressure; mild supplier-concentration ease. Leave structural difficulty / importance / maturity intact.
